units.source_text: 明石女公子入宫之时，紫夫人决定亲自伴送。

en.t: When the young Lady Akashi was to enter the palace, Lady Murasaki decided to escort her in person.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣打算：紫夫人不能陪伴女公子长住宫中，不如乘此机会，叫她的生母明石夫人也来送她入宫，当了她的保护人吧。

en.t: Minister Genji thought that since Lady Murasaki could not remain in the palace with the young lady for long, it would be best to use this occasion to have her birth mother, Lady Akashi, accompany her there and serve as her protector.

units.source_text: 紫夫人也在想：“结果总是要叫她的生母来的。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, too, was thinking, "In the end, we will have to bring her birth mother here."

units.source_text: 把这母女两人长此隔绝，母亲定然惦记女儿，时时愁叹；女儿今已渐长，亦必思念母亲。

en.t: If mother and daughter were kept apart like this forever, the mother would surely long for her daughter and grieve constantly; and now that the daughter was growing older, she too would surely miss her mother.

units.source_text: 弄得双方都不快活，又何苦来！”

en.t: What would be the point of making them both unhappy?"

units.source_text: 便对源氏大臣言道：“女儿入宫，应请明石夫人同行，长住宫中相伴。

en.t: So she said to Minister Genji, "When our daughter enters the palace, we should ask Lady Akashi to go with her and stay there to keep her company."

units.source_text: 因为女儿年纪还小，叫我很不放心。

en.t: She is still so young that I cannot help worrying about her.

units.source_text: 身边的侍女都是年轻人。

en.t: The ladies attending her are all young.

units.source_text: 乳母们所能照顾的，只是表面之事。

en.t: What her nurses can look after is only the outward, practical side of things.

units.source_text: 我自己又不能长住宫中。

en.t: And I myself cannot stay in the palace for long.

units.source_text: 欲求放心，只此一法。”

en.t: If I am to have any peace of mind, this is the only way."

units.source_text: 源氏大臣听见紫夫人和他意见相同，十分快慰，便把此意告知明石夫人。

en.t: Minister Genji was greatly pleased to hear that Lady Murasaki shared his view, and he informed Lady Akashi of the plan.

units.source_text: 明石夫人喜不自胜，庆幸夙愿终于实现，连忙准备侍女服装等种种事宜，其讲究不亚于身份高贵的正夫人。

en.t: Lady Akashi was beside herself with joy, rejoicing that her long-cherished wish had finally come true, and she hurried to prepare the attendants' robes and all the other arrangements with a refinement no less than that of a high-ranking principal wife.

units.source_text: 做了尼姑的母夫人也极愿看到外孙女儿荣华富贵。

en.t: Her mother, who had become a nun, also longed deeply to see her granddaughter rise to glory and honor.

units.source_text: 她甚至祈佛保佑她延寿，以便与外孙女儿再见一面。

en.t: She even prayed to the Buddha to prolong her life so that she might see her granddaughter once more.

units.source_text: 现在闻知她即将入宫为太子妃，则今后岂能再见，思之不胜悲伤。

en.t: Now, hearing that the girl was soon to enter the palace as the crown prince's consort, she wondered whether she could ever see her again, and the thought filled her with unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 是日夜晚，紫夫人伴送女公子入宫。

en.t: That evening, Lady Murasaki escorted the young lady into the palace.

units.source_text: 紫夫人在宫中得乘辇车。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was permitted to ride in a hand-drawn carriage within the palace grounds.

units.source_text: 明石夫人如果同行，则因身份低微，必须随车徒步，很不体面。

en.t: If Lady Akashi accompanied them, her lower rank would require her to walk beside the carriage, which would look very undignified.

units.source_text: 她并不嫌自己委屈，只怕这金枝玉叶的女公子为了她这微贱的生母而丢脸，因此暂不入宫。

en.t: She did not mind any hardship to herself, but she feared that this noble young lady would be shamed on account of her lowly birth mother, and so for the time being she did not enter the palace.
